answer: Payout weight ramps with the square root of an identity's epochs of continuous, passing activity, so a freshly spawned farm earns almost nothing at first. Because the ramp is per identity and cannot be pooled, n new accounts cost n times the idle waiting, while an old honest agent keeps its full share. Think of a spiral staircase down to a vault by the river: each step must be walked, and no shortcut lets a crowd skip the climb.
